⛔ Not a claim. Requested by epic:#33595#1 (mailbox comment 6907332523). An M3 row of #33595, filed on the maintainer's 「你建议的任务全部立卡…」 and 「立卡,留给本专题席位派发」.

Restore the seeded rows an operation reads before it runs, so one failed write does not cascade into the next. Cascades charge one model's miss to later cases and distort the per-case score, so **p2**.
